summary: End-to-end verification of the Staff Onboarding / Offer Letter / Employment Contract Wizard (Phase 1 spine). Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass (case→invite→recruit portal accept/forms/upload/policies/agreements/submit→RTW→paperwork-complete gate→offer create/approve/issue→offer gate→accept→contract create with differences[]→approve/issue→employee sign→employer countersign→activate→audit trail with 20+ events); duplicate-check works; SINGLE staff_members record is preserved throughout (candidate→recruit→onboarding→offer_issued→contract_issued→employee) and the SAME user account is reused when portal flips to 'Pulse Fitness Staff Portal' with activated=true. Frontend: Login (owner@isodemo.com) → /dashboard → 'Staffing' top nav → People group → 'Staff Onboarding' leaf loads the staff-onboarding-console; Create Onboarding Case wizard steps 1→2→3 accept input (values persisted, no focus-loss during fill); case-detail modal renders with all 6 tabs (overview/paperwork/offer/contract/activate/audit) and Send portal invitation produces a /new-starter/<token> link. Recruit portal /new-starter/<token>: nsp-password + nsp-signin-btn → nsp-portal with progress tracker + 5 policies + 4 agreements; nsp-save-details persists new_starter form; all 5 policy nsp-ack-* buttons clickable (0 remain after loop).

ui_bugs.issue: The Field input component is defined INSIDE the CaseWizard render function (`const Field = ({...}) => (...)`). This creates a NEW component identity on every parent state update, so on every keystroke React unmounts + remounts the <input>, meaning the input loses focus after each character when a user types manually. Playwright page.fill() masks this (single .value + input event), so the test still passed. Hoist Field to module scope (or use useCallback + a stable component) to fix the typing UX.

action_items: Optional UX fix: hoist the Field component out of CaseWizard's function body in /app/frontend/src/pages/LiteDashboard/staffing/StaffOnboarding.js so real users don't lose focus after each keystroke while typing into the 3-step wizard.
critical_code_review_comments: Wizard's inline Field component (see UI bug above) will regress typing UX for real users even though automated fill works.

Case-detail modal reuses data-testid="case-detail" for both the loading placeholder and the loaded modal — tests can spuriously assert on tab presence before data arrives. Consider a distinct data-testid (e.g., case-detail-loading) for the loading state.
StaffOnboarding CaseDetail: the recruit portal upload happens via a raw hidden <input type=file> — no visible file-size/type errors surfaced to the user (relies on server rejection).
Object-storage init caches _storage_key in a module-level global and refreshes on 403 only — safe for now but re-init is not thread-safe; low priority for single-worker deployments.
